study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Wolfers et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Replicating extensive brain structural heterogeneity in individuals with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: All three samples (Discovery, Replication 1, Replication 2) were drawn from the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study at Oslo University Hospital, each acquired on a different MRI scanner. Discovery: 1.5T Siemens MAGNETOM Sonata; Replication 1: 3T GE 750 Discovery; Replication 2: 3T GE Signa HDxT. All participants were recruited from the same population and catchment area with no overlap between samples.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study, approved by the Regional Committee for Medical Research Ethics and the Norwegian Data Inspectorate (Doan et al., 2017)." ... "All participants were recruited from the same population and catchment area but there was no overlap between the discovery and replication samples."

answer.TOP (Discovery sample): normative model training/testing (10-fold CV on 256 HC); clinical application to 163 SZ and 190 BP

answer.TOP (Replication 1): normative model training/testing (10-fold CV on 400 HC); clinical application to 94 SZ and 116 BP

answer.TOP (Replication 2): normative model training/testing (10-fold CV on 312 HC); clinical application to 105 SZ and 61 BP

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Three independent normative models were estimated, one per sample/scanner. For each sample, GPR normative models were trained and tested under 10-fold cross-validation on healthy controls, then applied to patients with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder to map individual deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we estimated the normative range for this model in healthy individuals under 10-fold cross-validation, and then applied one model across all healthy individuals to patients with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder." ... "we here report an attempt to replicate and extend our initial findings in two independent samples acquired on different scanners following an identical analytical procedure as in our previous discovery study."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Wolfers2021.pdf.md: Methods / 2.4 Normative modeling, L110-L112; Introduction, L88

model-1.model-name: Discovery normative model (1.5T Siemens Sonata, GPR)

model-2.model-name: Replication 1 normative model (3T GE 750 Discovery, GPR)

model-3.model-name: Replication 2 normative model (3T GE Signa HDxT, GPR)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Three separate normative models were built, each using healthy controls from one sample under 10-fold cross-validation. The overall-phase N reflects the total number of healthy controls per sample. Exact train-phase N per fold is not reported but can be inferred as approximately 90% of total N per fold.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "For replication sample 1, we included 94 patients with a schizophrenia diagnosis, 116 patients with a bipolar disorder diagnosis and 400 healthy individuals. As the replication sample 2, we included 312 healthy individuals, 105 with schizophrenia diagnosis and 61 with bipolar diagnosis. As the discovery sample, we selected 256 healthy individuals, 163 patients with schizophrenia and 190 with bipolar disorder."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Wolfers2021.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1 Participants, L94; Table 1, L66-L73

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics are reported in Table 1 for healthy controls of each sample as mean +/- std. The normative model forward plots (Figure 1) show age range approximately 20 to 70 years, but specific min/max per sample are not reported. Train-phase age statistics are not separately reported because of 10-fold CV design (the overall-phase HC are both the train and test set under CV).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1: Discovery Healthy Age (mean +/- std) = 34 +/- 9.5; Replication 1 Healthy Age = 34 +/- 11.3; Replication 2 Healthy Age = 30 +/- 8.0. Figure 1 caption: "the slope of a linear approximation of the normative model ... across the entire age range from 20 to 70 years"
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Wolfers2021.pdf.md: Table 1, L72; Figure 1 caption, L124

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Table 1 reports Male (%) for healthy controls in each sample. Female N and % were inferred by subtraction from total N. Discovery: 256 HC, 54.70% male -> 140 male, 116 female (45.3%). Replication 1: 400 HC, 50.25% male -> 201 male, 199 female (49.8%). Replication 2: 312 HC, 58.01% male -> 181 male, 131 female (42.0%). Train-phase sex breakdown is not separately reported due to 10-fold CV design.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1: Discovery Healthy Male (%) = 54.70%, N = 256; Replication 1 Healthy Male (%) = 50.25%, N = 400; Replication 2 Healthy Male (%) = 58.01%, N = 312.
